thread:
ella (sales): Sable Systems just sent an RFP — they want a completed capability matrix + ops diagrams + HSM/KMS details. Need a concise bundle we can attach. Can someone own?

mike (solutions): I can draft the capability matrix. Need to confirm which compliance certs they care about (SOC2, ISO, HIPAA?). Do we have a standard one-pager for Dedicated vs Private?

ella (sales): They listed SOC2 + PCI DSS in the RFP, and asked about on-prem HSM integration. They want POC options and estimated run-rate pricing for 3 nodes, burst to 6.

priya (security): PCI is uncommon but doable. For HSM integration we support KMIP + AWS KMS + customer HSM through Private. I'll pull our HSM connectivity doc and a redacted KMS SLA.

sam (pricing): For 3-node dedicated baseline, ballpark monthly: $X, with burst licensing add-on + egress estimate. I'll create a short pricing table. Need the target QPS/seq-length to firm numbers.

rafe (eng): Can you ask Sable for expected concurrency and average prompt length? Without that we should provide ranges. Also, for POC we can offer a 2-week dedicated pilot with telemetry export.

ella (sales): Asked them — they replied: 200 qps peak, 512 token average. Also they want the POC to include end-to-end telemetry and sample attacker threat model review.

mike (solutions): Ok I'll start the capability matrix outlining features: model catalog, routing policies, KV caching, quantization profiles, rollout controls, observability exports, and HSM options. Will flag where Dedicated vs Private differ.

priya (security): For the questionnaire answers: short yes/no plus brief notes. Example: "Data residency: Yes — private deployments can be VPC-only; Hosted: data retention policy 30d. Details attached." I’ll prepare the Qs/As.

sam (pricing): Draft pricing table uploaded to GDrive: https://drive.redwood/example/sable-pricing-v1 — can reviewers check numbers? :eyes:

mike (solutions): Quick note on the capability matrix: include a row for "Automatic KV cache" with the performance delta (x2 token throughput typical). Also add a note on graceful fallback rules (hosted -> dedicated -> private) for resilience.

rafe (eng): For HSM integration, add this snippet to the attachments so Sable's infra can verify:
```
# example curl to validate KMS trust
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://private.redwood.example/v1/kms/verify
```
Keep it redacted.

ella (sales): priya, mike, sam — can you have a packaged bundle (matrix + Qs/As + pricing + ops diagram + two sample attachments) ready by EOD PST? They want to send to procurement tomorrow.

priya (security): I can finish the questionnaire answers and redacted HSM runbook by 15:30 PST.

mike (solutions): I'll push the capability matrix + diagrams to the drive folder and ping legal for any redactions by 16:30.

sam (pricing): I'll finalize numbers and include a brief note about discounts for annual commits. Done by 17:00.

doc-bot: New files uploaded to https://drive.redwood/example/sable-rfp-bundle {capability_matrix.pdf, security_qna.pdf, pricing_table.xlsx, ops_network_diagram.png} :package: 

ella (sales): Amazing — I'll assemble the response and run a 30m pre-send review at 17:30. Please join if you're free. Thanks team :tada:
